parse.text:
Unobtainable Unit
This unit is currently unobtainable since Update 12 - My Hero Academia Update

Overview

Blade Beast (Past) is a Secret Limited unit. He can only be obtained by completing a Devil City Secret Portal, and chances are guaranteed if it's the host.

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.

Selling

Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.

Trivia

  • Denjy's bleed damage is 50% of his damage
  • He is able to get unshinyed for 3 Star remnants.
  • He is second unit who is considered a palette swap of another unit, his case being Blade Beast (Hybrid), with the other case being Mecha Tyrant, who is a palette swap of Tyrant (Final).
    • This rate, if you place 2 Blade Beast (Hybrid)s and 2 of Denjys, and you place another one of Chainsaw or Denjy, an error pops up. [Confirmation Needed]
